100
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL   ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 14, 2006/Phalguna 23, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries and
Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Parking facility for private planes
*321. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
 Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of Corporate
Houses are rushing in to buy business jets
and turbo prop planes for their top brass
and also queuing up to park at the hangars
at the Airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government propose
to take to accommodate such private planes
at the Airports?
Fake notes through ATM
†*322. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the incidents
of finding fake notes through ATM
machines of various banks have been
brought to the notice of Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of banks brought to the
notice of Government where such incidents
had taken place; and
(d) the action taken by Government
against the guilty persons?
Rate of interest on loans by NABARD
*323. SHRI N.K.
PREMACHANDRAN:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
 Will the Minister of  FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the interest rate allowed by the
NABARD for the agricultural loans;
(b) whether Government are aware that
the interest rate exceeds when the agriculture
loans of NABARD are routed through the
Co-operative and other commercial banks
for the agriculture; and
(c) whether Government consider to
extend the agricultural loans to farmers at
the interest rate prescribed by the
NABARD and the reaction of Government
thereto?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

101
Excavations undertaken by ASI
*324. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of  TOURISM AND
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Archaeological Survey
of India (ASI) has undertaken excavations
during the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the details of new discoveries of
historic significance made during the
excavations by the different circles?
Progress of water management
programmes
*325. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:  Will
the Minister of  WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that restructured
Command Area Development and Water
Management Programmes have not achieved
the desired results and it is progressing at
snail's speed;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) what was the total area in which the
work has been completed under the said
programme so far; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to accelerate the speed of work
under the said programme?
Increase in revenue from petroleum
products
†*326. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
 Will the Minister of  FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite low
rate of tax on petroleum in the year
2005-06, the tax revenue is estimated to be
rupees 5,115 crores;
(b) if not, what are Government's
estimate in this regard, and whether this
amount is more than the revenue amount
of 4699 crore rupees in the year 2004-2005;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for which the revenue amount
during this year is more as compared to
that of last year?
New guidelines for penalties for adultera-
tion in fuel by dealer/petrol pumps
*327. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that penalties for
adulteration in fuel by dealer/petrol pump
operators have been reduced/weakened
under new guidelines;
(b) what were the penalties for adulteration
earlier and what are they now; and
(c) what are the reasons for reducing
them?
Production of bio-diesel
*328. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO:  Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government consider higher
production of bio-diesel as substitute to
petroleum, keeping in view the spiraling
global petroleum prices;
(b) if so, the steps taken in this regard;
(c) the comparative cost of importing
petroleum and producing bio-diesel;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

102
(d) whether Government propose to
encourage R&D in inventing petroleum
substitute;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor and the
strategy to meet the future requirement?
Future projections of domestic and
Foreign Direct Investment
*329. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
 Will the Minister of  FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) when he proposes to actually
translate his declared assertion that  India
has a competitive advantage in areas of
manufacturing, services, BPO sectors etc.
by ensuring greater investment both
domestic and FDI; and

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the March 14, 2006/Phalguna 23, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Heavy Industries and
Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
Losses due to strike by AAI employees
†2246. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the losses suffered by Government
due to strike in the first week of February,
2006 in protest against handing over Delhi
and Mumbai airports to the private sector;
and
(b) whether sufficient efforts were not
made earlier to avoid the said strike?
Shortage of parking bays at Mumbai
Airport
2247. SHRI RAJ KUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Mumbai
Airport does not have adequate number of
parking bays for aircrafts for night parking;
(b) if so, whether airlines have been
asked by AAI to park aircrafts overnight at
neighbouring airports like Pune,
Ahmedabad etc.; and
(c) what is the response of the airlines
to this request?
Direct air service between Amritsar
and London
2248. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
start direct flights from Amritsar to London
in near future;
(b) the status of the proposal; and
(c) by when, inaugural flight is likely to
start?
Construction of bays at airports
2249. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India is in the process of
construction of 143 bays at 45 airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

506
(c) the details of non-metro airports that
are proposed to be upgraded to world-class
standards indicating those falling in the State
of Orissa?
Expenditure incurred on training of
pilots
2250. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount incurred by Government
on the training of pilots of Government
owned airlines during each of the last three
years;
(b) whether Government are aware that
these pilots are lured by private airlines
with lucrative offers;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government for the protection of interests
of the pilots and also Government owned
airlines?
Guidelines on helicopter operations
2251. SHRI R.P. GOENKA : Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that revised
comprehensive guidelines have been issued
recently to tighten the norms for helicopter
operations in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, especially
those relating to assessment of weather
forecasting in the hilly areas where weather
can change very fast?
Sanction of a new modern airport for
Chennai
2252. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is a move for sanction
of a new Modern International airport for
Chennai as has been done for Bangalore in
the wake of heavy spurt and steep increase
of traffic in Chennai due to the growth of
information technology, the proposal of
diverting all flights bound for South-East
Asian countries through Chennai Airport
and the need of patients from Asian
countries for fairly cheap and qualitative
treatment at Chennai; and
(b) whether the Chief Minister of Tamil
Nadu has already raked up a proposal for a
new airport at the cost of around Rs. 1000
crores in an extent of 2000 acres?
New International airports
2253. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of airports which were
given the status of international airports
during the last three years;
(b) whether Government propose to
declare some more airports as international
airports; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Slow progress of airport
modernisation
2254. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

507
are moving at a snail's pace so far as
modernisation of country's airports is
concerned; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Flying requirement for issue of
licence
2255. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the pilots including in
private airlines are not fully acquiring the
flying experience as stipulated in Civil
Aviation rules; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Revamping of boards of IA and AI
2256. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to revamp the boards of IA and AI;
(b) whether it is a fact that as a part of
revamping Government are thinking of
appointing functional directors;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d)
